text: In the 1980s Samantha Hughes, a cash-strapped college student, [accepts four hundred dollars to babysit|trigger|saying yes to an offer] at the Ulmans' remote mansion, only to learn she will be minding an unseen mother upstairs. Alone in the creaking house during a lunar eclipse, she finds photographs of another family, orders a pizza from a number Mr. Ulman suggests, and climbs toward a door on the third floor, unaware of [the ritual the family has planned|origin|secret worshippers among us] around [a pentagram drawn on the floor|images|holy and occult objects].
